end.name: Angelus Hut

via.name: Robert Ridge Route (poled ridge route)

via.name: junction with the Speargrass Creek Route

evidence: From the Mt Robert car park, a steep zigzag track (the Pinchgut Track) climbs up to the junction with Paddys Track (Bushline Hut is 30 min from junction).
Follow the poles down to the lake and hut.
Follow this for 4.9 km to the car park at the end.

not_on_route.name: Bushline Hut
not_on_route.quote: Bushline Hut is 30 min from junction

doubts: The page does not describe a return; recorded as one way from DOC's '12.2 km one way'. Start ref F2 is where the Pinchgut Track (the first track) meets Mt Robert Road at the car park. The ridge route is given the Robert Ridge Route ref (T7) from the page title; the text itself calls it 'the route along the ridge'. The lake is not named.
